about: Hand-written layout of scene.village (F-11; ux/scenes/village.md 2, 2.1, 3, 4): plan metres, +x = east (azimuth 90°, the road to Syracuse), +y = north, the road at z = 0. Rotation 0, so glTF x = plan x and glTF z = -plan y. place.melos-home is L-shaped; the navmesh marks convex areas only, so it is three rectangles with the same id (village.md 2.1). The first spot of each place that is not auto: false is where a character with no spot stands (data 16:01Z): well-side, sister-sheep, groom-work. The players' start and landing spots are auto: false.
